method: Exact signed-weight interval bounds for independent full-range activations; eight global phase prefixes and all multiply/reduction-tree nodes checked; no tensor samples or simulation.
scope: Frozen ROM model and legal eight-phase pipeline transactions only. Does not preserve arbitrary unconstrained signed32 partial_sums as a generic module contract.

packing.weight_flat: LSB element index = (output_channel*CIN+input_channel)*K*K+tap; signed int8 two-complement.
packing.bias_flat: LSB element index = output_channel; signed int32 two-complement.
packing.activation: window_flat index = tap*CIN+input_channel; L1 zero extends uint8; L2-L5 sign extend int16.

conclusion.recommended_bias_addition: Even with signed32 accum/sum_stage, explicitly sign-extend both operands to signed33 for the bias addition before signed32 saturation; preserve latency and handshake. RTL changes require regression.
not_proven: RTL equivalence after a future implementation edit
